# Original local note placement

This developer fixture preserves all 738 raw events of the second original Focus song generated by unchanged v9 `SessionPlanner(91031, PRESETS['Focus'], True)`. Its original start is 98.46153846153847 seconds, placed at frame 3,150,769. The complete original render has 4,647,880 local frames. The manifest records the complete song metadata and independently derived local body boundaries.

`session_render.render_song` passes each event's `local_time` to the original placement functions. `render_session` then places the complete song at `round(song['start_seconds']*32000)`. The frozen endpoint triples therefore add a supplied integer origin to the original rounded local onset. Harmonic hold/release and bass combined-duration rounding retain the PR22 original expressions. Percussion ignores these gate/release fields when rendering; its encoded metadata uses local endpoint rounding before integer placement.

The previous absolute-event onset differs by one frame for 161 events in this song. Fifteen compact probes cover even/odd half-frame onsets, arbitrary relocation independent of the source origin, all percussion instruments, the inclusive timeline limit, overflow, zero rounded holds, and local ordering hidden by coarse absolute timestamps. Seven observations execute the unchanged original `place`/`add_note` functions and record their actual local start and placed length. Source hashes and AST-extracted call arguments identify the original placement clock.

The existing default importer, native-v1 planning, serialized endpoint format, raw v9 files, and all older fixtures remain independent compatibility gates. Exact integers allow no frame tolerance. This fixture does not assert that every original song has been rendered or that native-v1 plans reproduce the original Python planner.

Regeneration permits at most `2e-15` seconds of difference in event `duration` only: Linux and macOS `log1p` produced a `1.7763568394002505e-15` second difference when subtracting the nearby ramp times for one snare. Every other raw field, type, song value and integer layout remains exact. All regenerated endpoint triples and absolute/local disagreement indices must also match exactly. The frozen event and manifest bytes retain their original hash checks; no frame or waveform tolerance changes.

Run `python3 -B tools/reference/verify-reference-placement.py --integrity` without numerical dependencies, then `.tools/reference/bin/python3 -B tools/reference/verify-reference-placement.py` to repeat the original placement calls in the pinned environment. The explicit freezer refuses replacement without `--replace`; CI never invokes it. New audio integration tests compare bounded rendering with an independently localized legacy import, while a complete later-song render remains ignored local diagnostic evidence. Its predeclared full pre-gain limits are maximum absolute error `1e-5` and RMS `1e-6`; protected output uses the existing peak-stage `2e-6` / `2e-7` limits. These do not change any existing audio acceptance gate.
